items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: You remember Artie Shaw had the other band that went to Honolulu. with Dave Tough.

ctx.x: You were supposed to go... there was a certain thing like that, Jo, that I remember quite well. I was with Cab Calloway when my turn came and there was also that same thing that I was supposed to go. The musicians black or white - Sy Oliver, most of us - were given first preference of the service -
You remember Artie Shaw had the other band that went to Honolulu. with Dave Tough.
So I wanted to know what happened to Lester, why nobody was there to see what branch of the service did he go into?
